label: No unexplained absence at roots, from essence-grounded modality and positive ESSENCE_6
meaning: Fix an actual root r at w and a determination d that r lacks while some admissible profile q contains all of r's determinations and d (an unexplained absence). Positivity makes every ESSENCE_6 condition on r's profile hold of q. Essence-grounded modality then gives a world v accessible from w at which r has every member of q, in particular d. Necessity of the root's absences gives r the determination d at w, a contradiction. So no actual root has an unexplained absence. The derivation is a relocation: under N, EM and factivity of essential conditions, positivity is equivalent to the conclusion (Lean-only positivityOfNoUnexplainedAbsence), so the argument separates N and EM from the contested load, which sits on positivity; under the necessity direction of member grounding positivity is in turn equivalent to carriage (positiveEssenceFromCarriage with carriedOfPositive), a second relocation. The conclusion covers only case (iii): an absence of noesis made inadmissible with the root's profile (case i or ii) satisfies all three premises and the conclusion. The main theorem uses no axioms. The Comparator companion essenceControls (three Mathlib axioms; the #2153 carrier with the open family, the source the only actual root) gives a positive witness and, for each premise, a row where it fails, the other two hold and the conclusion fails: a contingent lack of noesis (N fails), a necessary lack that no nature grounds (EM fails), and a nature with the negative clause 'lacks noesis' (positivity fails). The rows are assignments of the stated relations, not models of essence.

strong_version_needed.61a0b3e6-b115-4533-9148-82b17b149616: The weaker carriage premise gives an essential condition only at extensions in which no root determination requires a lack; with N and EM alone it does not exclude an unexplained absence (row 3 of carriageControls has a carried clause cutting off an admissible extension). It suffices together with the necessity direction of member grounding, which is the separate registered route positiveEssenceFromCarriage.
